ops.title: Make CCI tail filtering and status reads proportional to relevant records
ops.description: Owner: cci_grep_hotpath. Root observed cci tail --drive durable-agents-rebuild --since 36h -n 80000 --json --budget 300000000 at about83percent CPU; actual exited caller env/output volume UNKNOWN. Read-only EXPLAIN proves session cross-drive recipient predicate SCAN records plus correlated json_each; JSON annotation Resolvers scans also_resolves globally. Next: CI-only actual-tail baseline counters peer/nonpeer N32/10000 irrelevant history plus resolver projection, then return bounded native indexed-recipient/resolver design for root verdict before decision-dense implementation. Preserve all requested output and cross-drive semantics. No local tests/builds/dataqueries/benchmark. Evidence FE/cci-tail-query-plan.json and cci-tail-diagnosis.json. Root serializes installation.

ops.text: Actual CLI CI reproduces irrelevant-history scaling N32/10000 for peer versus nonpeer and global resolver annotation with exact output and cross-drive delivery assertions

Root-approved bounded native design reuses actual schema/write paths and preserves ordering filters limits budget JSON status errors and cross-drive delivery; independent review and regression CI prove reduced operation counts and full80000 requested output
